what: Proposed cap-overflow warning attributes every remaining over-cap state to pinned entries, but this loop can also stop because prune failures exhausted removable candidates.
scenario_or_breakage: If multiple rm -rf calls fail, the new post-loop warning would say pinned entries blocked full trim even though prune failures caused the cache to remain over cap.
suggested_fix: Change the warning text to name both causes, e.g. pinned entries or prune failures blocked full trim, or only use the pinning-specific text when PRUNE_FAILED_VERSIONS is empty.
